meta.name: learn
meta.description: Distill a reusable skill from anything — a directory, a URL, pasted notes, or what you just did together — or refine an existing skill with new learnings. Use when the user says '/learn', 'learn this', 'turn this into a skill', 'capture this workflow', 'make a skill from <source>', or 'improve/update the <name> skill'. Produces or updates a .claude/skills/<name>/SKILL.md authored to NanoClaw's skill guidelines. (This CREATES or REFINES a skill from a source; it does not install existing skills from a registry.)

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 从任何来源提炼或改进可复用的技能
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果经常需要把操作流程固化为可复用的技能
copy.tagline_en: Distill or refine a reusable skill from any source
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you often need to turn workflows into reusable skills

howto.what: 把一份来源（目录、网址、粘贴的笔记，或你们刚才一起做的事）整理成可复用的技能，写出 .claude/skills/<名称>/SKILL.md；也能按新内容就地改进已有技能。
howto.when: 当你输入 /learn，或说「把这个变成技能」、「更新某个已有技能」时触发。

say.text: /learn 把刚才我们做的这套流程整理成技能
/learn https://example.com/docs 照着做个用法技能
say.note: 读取该页面并写成技能

say.text: /learn 更新一下 wow-on-steam-deck 这个技能
say.note: 就地改写已有技能，不盲目覆盖

howto.what_en: Turns a source — a directory, URL, pasted notes, or the work you just did — into a reusable skill at .claude/skills/<name>/SKILL.md, or refines an existing skill with new learnings.
howto.when_en: Triggers when you type /learn, ask to turn something into a skill, or ask to improve/update an existing named skill.

say_en.text: /learn turn what we just did into a skill

say_en.note: Fetches the page and authors a skill
Edits the existing skill in place
